title: Sparrow customer handoff + quick config scratch
content:
Notes and TODO - quick brain dump for customer 'Sparrow' handoff

Context:
- Customer: Sparrow Analytics (seed-1000), uses VPC private deployment, strict egress policy.
- Kickoff: 2025-06-20
- POC target: embedding/search + chat endpoint for internal app.

Immediate checklist:
- [ ] Confirm VPC peering CIDR with infra (action: Diego) — need /16 vs /24 conflict
- [x] Generate dedicated service account for runtime (created 2025-06-19)
- [ ] Validate KMS key policy for model keys (Priya to confirm)
- [ ] Run initial smoke test on staging private control plane (me)

Config snippets (notes):
- runtime.env:
  REDWOOD_ENV=private
  MODEL_VARIANT=vicuna-13b-8bit
  KV_CACHE_SIZE=12GB
- Kubernetes hint:
  resources:
    limits:
      nvidia.com/gpu: '1'
      memory: '48Gi'
- Quick curl (staging):
  curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b-8bit","input":"hi"}'

Known gotchas:
- Customer uses very short sequence lengths but high concurrency — suggest batch size 8, timeout 200ms
- Egress blocked to model catalog S3 bucket -> we need to mirror artifacts into customer bucket or use preloaded images.
- KMS: HSM-backed required for regulatory data (Sparrow legal). Need compliance sign-off.

Open questions:
- Can we allow ephemeral internet for model downloads during initial bootstrapping?
- What is SLA expectation for cold-starts? (they asked 99th p95 < 350ms but unclear)

Next steps (my personal to-do):
- [ ] Draft security HLD to attach to proposal (due 2025-06-27)
- [ ] Add Canary rollout plan using traffic-split on console
- [ ] Create eval set for regression testing (10 prompts each for search and chat)
- [ ] Add model quantization baseline numbers (latency / cost) to SE playbook

References:
- Jira: SE-4389 onboarding epic
- Confluence: Sparrow Onboarding page (link above)
- Slack: #se-sparrow-setup for async questions

Notes to self:
- Keep the first demo simple: embeddings + vector search, live chat later.
- If we can't get KMS approved quickly, propose 'customer-managed encryption at rest' as interim.

Timestamped quick logs:
2025-06-20 09:12 - Intro call: CTO cares about P95 latency, compliance, and offline mode.
2025-06-22 15:40 - Infra asked for exact CIDR: follow up via email.

Scratchpad end.
